request.spec:
A grade merge is now retroactive: for every person it moves, every grade record of theirs on the
merged grade becomes the other grade, so all their claims, whatever their date, use the other
grade's rates (and its terms and thresholds) from then on. Frozen figures and figures bound by a
statement are unchanged.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A grade merge is now retroactive: for every person it moves, every grade record of theirs on the

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A grade merge now rewrites every grade a moved person has on the merged grade, whatever its date. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests (the main test and scenarios 1–3).

**What changed:** only `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/grade/ApplyGradeMerge.java`. The merge works as before, giving each person on the merged grade today the other grade from today. After that, for each of those people it:
- changes the grade they were first given, if it's the merged grade (this one covers their earliest claims);
- changes every dated grade record of theirs on the merged grade to the other grade.

All of their claims, whatever their date, now use the other grade's rates, grace and rate checks. The audit lines the test expects come out as is. The person's own lines show their figures before the earlier records are rewritten, and the pipeline's final rollup step then records the fully retroactive figures.

**Frozen and statement figures:** no new code was needed. The existing claim calculation already uses a settled claim's frozen due or a statement's bound figure before working anything out from the person's grade, so those don't move.

**Two behaviours to be aware of:**
- **Payment terms on existing claims stay the same.** A claim's terms and due-by date are fixed when it's created, so after a merge only new claims pick up the other grade's terms. I read "its terms … from then on" that way.
- **Past views show the new grade.** The records are changed in place and the date they were made is kept, so looking at the sheet as of an earlier day also shows the merged-into grade.

No front-end or schema changes were needed.
